title: 🏛️ RBI Draft Policy — Bank Dividend Payout Cap Raised from 40% to 75% of PAT
summary: RBI proposed raising dividend payout ceiling for commercial banks from 40% to 75% of adjusted PAT under a 10-bucket capital-linked structure based on CET1 ratios after deducting net NPAs.

blocks.content: **Overview**: RBI proposed raising dividend payout ceiling for commercial banks from 40% to 75% of adjusted PAT under a 10-bucket capital-linked structure based on CET1 ratios after deducting net NPAs.

items: **RBI Draft Framework Proposes Raising Bank Dividend Payout Cap to 75% of PAT** (Page 19): RBI proposed raising dividend payout ceiling for commercial banks from 40% to 75% of adjusted PAT under a 10-bucket capital-linked structure based on CET1 ratios after deducting net NPAs.

blocks.title: 🎯 Exam Focus & Pitfalls
blocks.content: Pay close attention to statutory outlays, regulatory deadlines, and institutional authority under Commercial Bank Capital Distribution & Profit Allocation. Replaces 40% cap with 75% dividend ceiling linked to CET1 capital adequacy and net NPA deductions.
